test_inputs.explanation: The only concrete value visible in the execution summary was the admin categories URL (base_url). The other fields were not recorded in the summary, so I supplied sensible, replayable values consistent with the form fields described in the tool schema: a typical root node label ('Bot Root Category (0)'), a new category name, an empty url_key to let Magento auto-generate the slug, common boolean choices ('Yes'), a common display mode ('Products only'), a CMS block example label from the schema ('Home & Decor'), and a 30s wait timeout. These values allow a tester to reproduce adding a subcategory at the observed admin URL.
